title: Sun Tickles
direction: Use small, bright-feeling pinprick impacts in asymmetric groups. Keep the water lively rather than heavy. The earlier 0:24.8 window is the more charming short demo; the ~1:24 window is the higher-contrast machine candidate.

sections.name: glints: opening
sections.note: Frequent asymmetric note pinpricks, with paired glints answering selected attacks. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
